faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating between English and Italian.

items.q: Does it get Italian noun genders right?
items.a: Yes, articles and adjectives agree correctly with the noun's gender, rather than a literal word-for-word translation.

items.q: Can it translate spoken Italian back to English?
items.a: Yes — speak Italian into the mic and get an English translation as text, with audio playback available.

items.q: Can it help with pronunciation, like double consonants?
items.a: Yes, tap the speaker icon to hear the Italian translation read aloud, useful for tricky double-letter sounds.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No, it runs in your browser on desktop or mobile — nothing to download.

items.q: Can I keep a running conversation instead of one-off translations?
items.a: Yes, each language pair keeps its own history, so a conversation stays together instead of scattering across separate translations.
